subject: af-post
title: AF.POST.------PHY.U.P.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 67 (WAM-9). The chart has no arrow; AF-POST (affinity postulation), the first title code, is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) is the partner. From the subject: TF, INFO-DY and POL-DY (political dynamics). From TF: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From VT-DY: WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). From INFO-DY: ALT-D (alternative definitions). From ALT-D: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From POL-DY: ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism). From ACC-FT: C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism). From C-FO-ACT: IST-F (isolated focus).
